messages:
maria_customer: Hey team — since Zenith-ML v1 went live this morning our p95 has jumped ~2.5x for mid-length requests (4k–8k tokens). Customers reporting slow interactive experiences. Any quick triage?
laura_support: @maria_customer sorry about that, filing an escalation. Can you paste an example request id or trace?
maria_customer: request id 6a7f3b2c, region eu-west-1. Repro rate ~10% of calls, not all. Happens more when input contains long code blocks or pasted docs.
laura_support: thanks. tagging infra & eng — @ivan_infra @sanjay_eng — looks like a new model onboarding related? Zenith-ML just rolled at 08:02 UTC.
ivan_infra: I can see a cluster-level P95 uptick in eu-west-1 around the same deploy. Initial top-level alert: svc-p95 > 350ms. Querying traces now.
ivan_infra: Traces show spikes in tokenize()/encode step, and a bunch of requests with large KV cache miss rates. Suspect tokenizer boundary differences causing extra token inflation.
sanjay_eng: copying sample trace: "tokenize_time=120ms, model_forward=50ms, kv_miss_penalty=180ms" — kv miss penalty is unusually high. Zenith's tokenizer changed BPE merges for long whitespace sequences; might be producing different tokenization that cancels prefix reuse.
laura_support: any quick mitigations we can apply to reduce customer impact?
sanjay_eng: short-term: route affected customers to the previous model variant (zenith-legacy) or enable prefix-caching bypass that forces reuse fallback. Both are config toggles. I'll prepare an A/B route.
emma_prod: Approving canary rollback for the affected tenants. Laura — do we have the list of affected tenants? Maria, can you share org id?
maria_customer: org-3345. Affected users are primarily editors using long code blocks.
laura_support: Initiating routing change to send org-3345 to zenith-legacy. @deploy-bot please create a canary route for org-3345 -> zenith-legacy.
deploy-bot: Created route canary: org-3345 -> model:zenith-legacy (10% gradual ramp option available).
ivan_infra: After routing ~80% of org-3345 traffic to legacy, p95 dropped back to baseline over 10 minutes. Confirming it's tokenizer-induced regression.
sanjay_eng: Root cause analysis plan: 1) reproduce tokenizer diff locally on samples 2) measure token inflation and kv-cache reuse delta 3) patch tokenizer merge table or introduce compatibility mode 4) bake+onboard new tokenizer build then roll out.
laura_support: Repro steps requested so we can provide customers. Sanjay — can you post commands/snippets to reproduce?
sanjay_eng: Repro snippet:
```bash
echo "<sample-long-doc>" > sample.txt
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('zenith_new.json'); print(t.encode(open('sample.txt').read()).tokens)"
# compare against zenith_legacy.json tokenizer output and look for token counts + boundary shifts
```
Also check kv trace from our runtime: `/api/v1/trace?req=6a7f3b2c` and look for `kv_hit=false` patterns.
laura_support: Nice. Maria — we'll keep you updated; we've routed your org to legacy model and opened a ticket (INC-2257). ETA for a proper fix?
sanjay_eng: If tokenizer table fix is straightforward, aim to ship a patch in 24–48h with canary. If deeper tokenization logic change is needed, will take longer. Will post progress in this thread.
emma_prod: Add regression alert to model-onboard runbook and tag product owners for Zenith.
maria_customer: Thanks for the quick response + workaround. Please keep me posted.
laura_support: Summary: Identified Zenith tokenizer boundary changes causing token inflation and KV-cache misses -> p95 spike for long-mid inputs. Mitigation: route affected orgs to zenith-legacy; eng working on tokenizer patch. Ticket INC-2257 created.
sanjay_eng: Follow-up note: we'll gather a small prompt set from maria to run automated tokenization diff tests. @maria_customer could you drop 3 representative samples in the ticket?
maria_customer: Done (attached to INC-2257).
laura_support: Closing the immediate escalation loop — will update when patch is ready. :thumbsup:
